Morgan: Heads up — EU H200 allocation from Nexa was pushed to next week. Vendor says it's a partial split and some units are stuck in FRA customs. Any updates on RMA / loaners?
Kevin (NexaSupply): Sorry for the noise — confirmed: 12/24 H200 batch. 8 units cleared, 4 held by customs for duties/doc mismatch. Working with broker now. ETA ~72h after docs. :handshake:
Sam: Can they expedite the manifest + proof of origin? Infra is scheduled to stage on Wed. If delayed we need loaner H100s or a model swap. @Rachel fyi for staging.
Kevin (NexaSupply): We can push a temporary AWB + manifest scan in ~2h. Customs flagged an HS-code mismatch (shown as 8471 vs 8542). They want a commercial invoice reclass.
Rachel: I can reissue the invoice but need the exact HS line. Procurement, pls confirm correct product taxonomy.
Josh: Procurement confirms model tag H200-A1, vendor part 042-HT. We classify under 8471.90 per previous shipments.
Kevin (NexaSupply): Customs is insisting on vendor-provided commercial description. I'll attach vendor CO and serial manifest shortly. Also note: depot moved 2 units to DOA queue — starting RMA flow.
Morgan: Also: 2 units arrived DOA at FRA depot — depot opened RMA case 7892. They want serials + photos. Kevin, can vendor pre-authorize depot swap to avoid routing back to vendor main DC?
Kevin (NexaSupply): Yes — we can pre-authorize a depot swap under warranty. Need photos, failure notes, and SN list. We'll issue return label and ship replacements from NL pool (closest).
Sam: SNs are H200-0021 and H200-0054. Photo folder uploaded: https://drive.redwood.example/ops/h200-failures (photos + depot log).
Morgan: Cost question: vendor quoted +8% uplift for air expedite and brokerage. If we route loaners instead, what's the cost delta?
Kevin (NexaSupply): Loaners: €12/unit/day + one-way freight. Air expedite: flat €1,500 per shipment + brokerage. For 4 units expedite ~€6k total vs loaners ~€288/day plus freight.
Josh: If we accept loaners we need a PO amendment. Can someone estimate days saved with loaners vs air expedite?
Rachel: Loaners available from NL pool with 24h pickup => ~48–72h to be staged. Air expedite would get units to depot in ~24h but customs could still hold them until docs fix.
Morgan: Plan: proceed with depot swap for the 2 DOA; issue 2 loaners for the staging gap; only air-expedite the 2 held units if docs are not cleared by EOD tomorrow. Sam to track and escalate. :white_check_mark:
Sam: On it. I'll open infra-ops/1718 and add timeline + owner. Will ping the customs broker first thing. :eyes:
Kevin (NexaSupply): I'll send CO, manifest, and RMA pre-auth by 08:00 CET. Thanks for coordinating.
infra-bot: Reminder — staging window Wed 09:00–15:00 CET. If <4 H200s available, rollout will rollback to previous config.
